findings: Default-mode independent restores on the same physical NPU and CPU affinity reproduce tolerance failure at global step 260; identical restored values do not guarantee identical default backward.

Differentiating exactly the same forward graph twice leaves logits gradients and regional score gradients exact, while embedding.weight and core.receive.embedding.weight gradients differ in default mode. This is direct backward nondeterminism evidence, not merely checkpoint-load speculation.

Enabling torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) yields exact repeated backward and two independent eight-update trajectories exact in all five compared categories and discrete/RNG/input checks for this checkpoint.

Zeroing ordinary-region second.bias gradients reduces parameter drift but still fails original private-state tolerance at step 260. It is an amplification-path intervention, not a successful fix or original-recovery qualification.
learning_exposure_interpretation: diagnostic repeated trajectories from one checkpoint; excluded from scientific learning-token totals
limits: One checkpoint/model/seed/LR/backend/physical-device combination was replayed; no full six-candidate qualification or long training was performed.

Individual native embedding/index-gradient kernels were not isolated from the complete backward graph; the earliest differing parameter gradients localize the surface, not a specific CANN kernel implementation.
The diagnostic adds a repeated-backward probe, hooks and CPU snapshot/gradient restore; it is not a performance benchmark.

The null-bias intervention checked equal total allocation bounds but did not record unconstrained-total boundary ties. The declared VJP treats exact boundary ties as slack, so it must not be advertised as a semantics-preserving code fix.
Deterministic trajectories are compared with each other. They do not retroactively reproduce or qualify the original nondeterministic reference trajectories; old failures remain unchanged.
Original owner warm-state pre-verification digest was not recorded. New diagnostics explicitly verify each restored live starting state; default independent fresh owners still diverge.
